notes.title: Summit Drive Demo Update Version 1.3.5
notes.content:
What was updated?Main Menu:
Main menu music added into the game

Camera pans closer to character when played

Option to select different mountain/maps has been added in preparation for the release

Version number added at the bottom of the screen

Fonts were changed due to copyright restrictions
Additional Updates:
Thomas Perrone will be doing the composition/OST for Summit Drive

Credit was added into the game
Bug Fixes:
Decreased collider of some trees found at the top of the mountain

Adjusted van hitbox

Fixed animation error on player(bird)

Pixelation effect does not reset when restarting the game



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45702466/2b0a82b4cc7e706dbeee95c67923eeb9a8303d1d.png"]

notes.title: 🚨 Important Warning 🚨
notes.content:
Be mindful
The game will only be officially available through:

Steam

My official Itch.io page

If you see Summit Drive offered on any other website or platform, it is not an official version and could be unsafe. Please don’t download it from unverified sources.



Stay safe, and thank you for supporting the game! 🚐



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45702466/74dc9750b652cd2011b7bcc9a992f734e92aa999.png"]

notes.title: GDWC Summer Season 2025 Finalist
notes.content:
What is next!
Summit Drive was also brought back to itch.io. I am working on a much larger update before Steam Next Fest and possibly some capsule art changes (quality changes). I will announce more on that soon. In the meantime I hope you enjoy the demo. 



Summit Drive will continue to be submitted to other festivals in the meantime. Thank you for being a part of the community. I will be working on a discord server as well sometime but in the meantime follow @lukekdev on X or Bluesky for dev-updates. 


New Trailer Soon
I am also editing for a new trailer soon!
